create.name: Gloria Krausse
create.bio:
Gloria Krausse is a certified Quantum-Touch practitioner, Reiki master and IHDS-certified Living Your Design guide based in Berlin, Germany. She came to Quantum-Touch in 2019 through Richard Gordon's work and, after her first seminar, took the method up as a regular personal practice. Her website, Human Design with Gloria, keeps two strands of work side by side.

The main strand is private, one-to-one Human Design guidance for adults who find decisions hard or feel driven by outside pressure. She uses the BodyGraph, worked out from the date, time and place of birth, to show how a person is built to decide and to spend energy, then helps them test that in daily life. This runs as a twelve-week Living Your Design course with video lessons and four private sessions, as single consultations, and through short paid audio teachings and a free online library of stories, articles and video clips. The second strand, kept deliberately separate, is energy healing: quiet sessions that combine Reiki with Quantum-Touch breath and body-awareness work, held online or in person in Berlin, with the client choosing light touch, hovering hands or no touch at all. She also posts short Human Design talks on her YouTube channel.

courses.title: Energy Healing with Gloria: Reiki and Quantum-Touch sessions
courses.description: Private one-to-one sessions that pair a gentle Reiki base with more focused Quantum-Touch breath and awareness work. Held online or in person in Berlin, fully clothed, with light touch, hands above the body or no touch, as the client prefers.

courses.title: Private Living Your Design (12 weeks)
courses.description: A twelve-week one-to-one introduction to living by your Human Design strategy and authority. It combines a library of recorded video lessons with four private hour-long sessions, recorded for later reference.

courses.title: Why You Still Can't Decide (audio diagnostic)
courses.description: A ten-minute voice-led audio for thinking through a stuck decision, paired with a full teaching video on the Ajna centre in Human Design.

free_resources.title: Energy healing resources and videos
free_resources.description: A small, growing collection on her site of short explanations and demonstrations, including two Quantum-Touch breathing techniques shown on video.

free_resources.title: Human Design Library
free_resources.description: A free library of her audio stories, articles and short Living Your Design video clips about decisions, pressure and energy. A free account is needed to enter.
